text:
maria (support): Hey team, Acme is reporting repeated 502/504s hitting our hosted API since ~09:10 UTC. They see timeouts while streaming and a bunch of model calls failing. Escalation ticket incoming.

acme-infra (customer): Confirming — spikes every ~30s, ~15% of requests get 502 or a truncated stream. Happening across regions. We rely on low lat for their product.

maria (support): Quick triage: traces from customer show upstream errors at the edge gateway, lots of `upstream_reset` and `upstream_connect_timeout`. Sample trace id: trace-0a1b2c3d.

sam (eng-sre): Copy. Pinging oncall. Can you grab edge proxy logs + envoy error counters for that timeframe?

lee (oncall): On it. I'm seeing a pattern: connection pool exhaustion on midproxy for tenant Acme, and Envoy `x-envoy-upstream-rq-timeout` and `x-envoy-upstream-rq-per-host-5xx`. Quick excerpt from logs: 
```
[09:11:02] envoy error: upstream_reset_before_response_started, upstream_host: 10.4.12.9
[09:11:02] envoy info: x-envoy-upstream-rq-timeout
[09:11:03] midproxy: connpool_exhaustion tenant=acme token=xyz
```

sam (eng-sre): Hmm looks like sudden burst of long-lived streaming requests from Acme causing connpool starvation. Any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: deploy finished: hostedapi-edge v2026.04.11 @ 08:47 UTC by tony. No rollbacks.

tony (platform): That deploy included a change to keepalive settings on the onramp layer (reduce idle timeout from 90s -> 30s) and a tweak to max concurrent streams per worker. Could be related.

maria (support): Customer says this started after their scheduled batch job at 09:05 UTC hitting the API with large streaming prompts. They have a sample curl: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"redwood-large","stream":true,"input":"<huge-prompt>"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```

acme-infra (customer): We can reproduce from our side: start 200 parallel long streams for ~2 minutes -> ~12% 502 / early EOF.

lee (oncall): Mitigation idea: temporarily increase onramp connection pool and bump keepalive to 120s for affected pool, or route Acme to a dedicated pool. Rolling a configuration hotfix now to increase connpool size by 2x for midproxy-acme shard.

sam (eng-sre): Also enable prefix KV caching fallback disabled? If streams hold KV caches they block workers. Check cache metrics. observability-bot, can you surface per-tenant connpool and active-stream metrics for last 30m?

observability-bot: metrics query: tenant.acme.active_streams=190 -> spike at 09:06; tenant.acme.conn_pool_waits=430; midproxy.pool_size=50; saturated=85%

sam (eng-sre): That's consistent. Looks like pool 50 -> 190 concurrent streams. Backpressure triggered and Envoy returned 502s.

lee (oncall): Hotfix applied: increased midproxy pool to 150 and raised onramp keepalive to 120s for the tenant shard. Watching.

maria (support): Noted. Customer running another batch now to repro if mitigated.

acme-infra (customer): Running now... 1m in: errors dropped to ~0.8%. Much better. Thanks.

sam (eng-sre): Next steps: 1) revert risky keepalive change in the main deploy PR and roll a safer config. 2) Capacity plan: ensure midproxy shards autoscale earlier based on active_streams. 3) Add a per-tenant streaming QPS guard + queueing to avoid blocking other tenants.

tony (platform): Will open PR to revert keepalive delta and add feature flag for per-tenant pool sizing. Also adding an alert: tenant.conn_pool_waits > 200 -> page oncall.

maria (support): Customer satisfied for now, leaving open until PRs merged. I'll update ticket with mitigations & repro steps.

lee (oncall): Filing incident note: brief surge caused connpool exhaustion due to unexpected long-lived streaming batch from customer + tightened keepalive from deploy. Mitigated by increasing pool and keepalive.

maria (support): Logging final repro steps for postmortem: 1) from customer: run 200 parallel curl streaming calls with large payloads for 2m. 2) Observe per-tenant active_streams spike -> midproxy pool saturated -> envoy upstream timeouts/502s. 3) Mitigate by increasing pool or routing to dedicated pool.

acme-infra (customer): Thanks team — we'll stagger our batch windows going forward. Appreciate the quick response :thumbsup:

sam (eng-sre): Adding doc links: runbook: https://confluence.redwood.example/runs/edge-connpool and alert dashboards.

maria (support): Closing thread once PRs merge and alert is in place.
